typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT [Recipient Medicaid ID] 			,[Recipient DOB] 			,[Admit Diagnosis Code] 			,[Admit Diagnosis Description] 			,[Place of Service] 			,[Type of Care] 			,[Admit Date] 			,[Admitting MD NPI] 			,[Admitting MD Name] 			,[Facility  Name] 			,[Facility NPI] 			,[Auth#] 			,[Status] 			,[Targeted Discharge Date]   FROM [DATA_EXCHANGE].[EXTRACT].[NV_TOC_IP_EXTRACT]     WHERE [EXCD_ID] = ?   ORDER BY [Recipient Medicaid ID]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceTableNVTOCIPEXTRACT
SourceTableNVTOCIPEXTRACT sink(input(
		Status as string,
		Recipient_Medicaid_ID as string,
		Facility_NPI as string,
		Admit_Date as string,
		Targeted_Discharge_Date as string,
		Place_Of_Service as string,
		Admitting_MD_Name as string,
		Auth_Number as string,
		Admitting_MD_NPI as string,
		Admit_Diagnosis_Code as string,
		Admit_Diagnosis_Description as string,
		Recipient_DOB as string,
		Type_Of_Care as string,
		Facility_Name as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Status,
		Recipient_Medicaid_ID = {Recipient Medicaid ID},
		Facility_NPI = {Facility NPI},
		Admit_Date = {Admit Date},
		Targeted_Discharge_Date = {Targeted Discharge Date},
		Place_Of_Service = {Place of Service},
		Admitting_MD_Name = {Admitting MD Name},
		Auth_Number = {Auth#},
		Admitting_MD_NPI = {Admitting MD NPI},
		Admit_Diagnosis_Code = {Admit Diagnosis Code},
		Admit_Diagnosis_Description = {Admit Diagnosis Description},
		Recipient_DOB = {Recipient DOB},
		Type_Of_Care = {Type of Care},
		Facility_Name = {Facility  Name})) ~> FlatFileInpatirnt
